title: Part 1 — they called for withdrawal, never an investigation
description: Series Part 1: green checked box “CALLED FOR PLATNER’S WITHDRAWAL — every statement” vs empty amber box “CALLED FOR AN INVESTIGATION — zero.”
alt_text: Dark card, part 1 of 3: “Why is no one calling for an investigation?” Within hours, officials demanded Platner leave the race; we swept every quoted statement in the reaction coverage. A green checked box: called for Platner’s withdrawal — every statement. An empty amber box: called for an investigation — zero. Italic: if you are certain enough to end a candidacy, why not certain enough to ask for the process with subpoenas?
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
